Digital-native direct-to-consumer models in beauty and snacks are disrupting traditional retail channels, creating asymmetric upside for small caps with e-commerce-led growth strategies.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap consumer names riding the domestic recovery, but stay nimble: COIN, BTEK, SMLE, ADES, AGAR, LUCY, NSSS, and ZONE are all up 8-11% on momentum, not fundamentals. Favor ADES (water) and AGAR (food) for defensive cash flows; avoid chasing ZONE or LUCY without earnings confirmation. Trim into strength if IDX consumer breadth fades below +0.5% next session.
